# What the Ghostty 1.4.0 embed changed in herdr's environment, captured on
# 2026-11-07 from builddir/src/corral with a stub herdr that dumped `env`.
# Placeholders: @EXE_DIR@ is the directory of the corral binary and
# @RESOURCES_DIR@ is GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR as corral saw it.
#
# The parent had HERDR_ENV, HERDR_PANE_ID, HERDR_SOCKET_PATH,
# HERDR_CONFIG_PATH, and VTE_VERSION set. The child was exec'd directly
# (its parent was corral, not a shell) on a pty sized 79x29.
set COLORTERM=truecolor
set GHOSTTY_BIN_DIR=@EXE_DIR@
set GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR=@RESOURCES_DIR@
set GHOSTTY_SHELL_FEATURES=cursor:blink,path,title
set GHOSTTY_SURFACE_ID=0x[0-9a-f]{16}
set TERM=xterm-ghostty
set TERMINFO=@RESOURCES_DIR@/../terminfo
set TERM_PROGRAM=ghostty
set TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION=1.4.0
append PATH=@EXE_DIR@
keep HERDR_SOCKET_PATH
keep HERDR_CONFIG_PATH
unset HERDR_ENV
unset HERDR_PANE_ID
unset VTE_VERSION
